claims.claim: Each depth-n concrete Cartesian dyadic box has side width 2^-n and cube volume 8^-n.
Each octree prefix cylinder equals the decoder preimage of its closed dyadic box almost everywhere.
Euclidean box indicators and octree prefix indicators correspond exactly under pullback and Hilbert adjoint transport.
Every finite-prefix cylinder indicator decomposes as a finite sum of singleton prefix indicators.
The concrete dyadic-box closed level equals the Block 39 transported Euclidean level.
The concrete dyadic-box hierarchy is nested and dense in cube L2.
The concrete dyadic-box orthogonal projections converge strongly to the identity.

nonclaims: No pointwise disjointness of closed sibling boxes is claimed; overlap is confined to null boundaries.
No generator consistency theorem is claimed.
No lattice-translation or propagator convergence theorem is claimed.
No dynamical gauge-field, gravity, cosmology, or empirical claim is made.
